from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        sm = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_AGG
        )
        draft = await sm(problem)
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.BINARIO_FINALIZE_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.BINARIO_FINALIZE_AGG
        )
        merged = await star(f"{problem}\n\nCandidate analysis/solution:\n{draft['response']}")
        final_star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.BINARIO_FINAL_CHECK_WORKER] * 2, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.BINARIO_FINAL_CHECK_AGG
        )
        solution = await final_star(f"{problem}\n\nProposed final answer:\n{merged['response']}")
        return solution["response"], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}
